evidence_summary: Core v6 results bit-for-bit identical to previously audited and accepted state (CYCLE_33242739705). Six representations pass both adversarial gates with meaningful fractal structure: center_projected_64dim (DEFAULT, JP=0.982), linear_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.685), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.678), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (JP=0.666), cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.616), hybrid_cited_0.3 (JP=0.955). Negative results preserved: citation role overclustering artifacts, pretrained legal embeddings language-dominated, v5 signal ablation hybrids fail on full corpus. Two new experiment scripts added (CPU-reduced finetune, out-of-sample generalization test) but neither has produced complete results — code is sound but execution incomplete. No regressions, no unsupported claims, no leakage detected.
